provenance.action-bg: button.tsx variant=default: bg-primary -> globals.css --primary (pure black light / oklch 0.922 dark, this checkout)

prop.tone.note: destructive variant exists (bg-destructive) but its color cells are out of this matrix's scope (default/neutral tone only, per Calendar-precedent scoping) — coverage gap vs Salt's 5 sentiments either way

prop.size.source: button.tsx size enum (default/xs/sm/lg + icon/icon-xs/icon-sm/icon-lg for icon-only)

prop.icon-only.source: button.tsx size: icon/icon-xs/icon-sm/icon-lg — square variants, size-9/6/8/10

behavior.loading.note: no built-in loading variant; composed by consumer

style.root.height.note: DECLARED DEFERRAL: shown at size=default only. Per-prop-value style resolution (height also = 24/32/40px at xs/sm/lg) needs a generator extension — cells keyed by prop value, analogous to byDensity but for the size prop — not yet built. Full values: xs 24px, sm 32px, default 36px, lg 40px.

style.root.padding.source: size=default: px-4; has-[>svg]:px-3 when carrying an icon

style.root.text-transform.note: no text-transform — shadcn buttons are sentence/label case as typed, unlike Salt's forced uppercase

style.root.background@active.note: no distinct active-state background; hover/active share the same treatment (no :active rule in source)

style.root.opacity@disabled.source: disabled:opacity-50 — 50%, NOT Salt's 40%; a real cross-system value difference

style.root.elevation.source: variant=outline only: shadow-xs; default/destructive/secondary/ghost/link carry no shadow

style.root.background@secondary-hover.note: button.tsx's outline variant className carries `hover:bg-accent` as its own literal, independent of the default variant's `hover:bg-primary/90` — the SAME accent token ghost's own hover already resolves via ghost-hover-bg, reused rather than re-derived (BUTTON-MATRIX.md finding 1)

style.icon.size.source: [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 = 1rem = 16px (default size); xs variant drops to size-3=12px
